messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Tomasz Nowak wrote the billing-api handover doc for Marcus on 2025-03-17. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- As of 2025-09-08, billing-api has a new dependency on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- As of 2025-03-19, the Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-05]
- The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-11-21, Team Dune reported that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-21]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-23]
- Changes to the billing service need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-09]
- INC-2025-017's root cause was an expired intermediate certificate, which took logins down. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]

- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
